_note: ST-05 canonical SEMANTIC-MUTATION model (roadmap parity-evidence §7 ST-05). A mutation is a single named WRITE to a canonical-state field — the causal, per-write layer BENEATH the per-frame state pillar (state-volatile-v1.json) and the persistent save pillar (state-map-v1.json). Where those pillars answer 'is the state EQUAL each frame / on disk?', a mutation stream answers 'WHICH write first diverged, and who wrote it?' — it fills ST-04's first_divergence.provenance seam (the WRITER behind a transition). Consumed by tools/parity/state_mutation.py; the R3 design + rationale live in docs/reference/state-mutations.md. This file is the R3 CONTRACT: the frozen event shape + the semantic/derived/noise class gate + the grounded event catalog. The CAPTURE PLATFORM (Frida post-write hooks / TTD) is deferred behind this consumer (roadmap rule 11 — build consumers before platforms); a producer emits events in THIS shape.

event_shape.logical_frame: [anchor:str, occurrence:int>=1, offset:int] — WHEN (the identity join key, roadmap §4.2; never an absolute present index).
event_shape.seq: int >= 0 — intra-frame ordering when a field is written more than once in one logical frame (the NET per-frame value = the highest-seq write).
event_shape.path: str — WHAT: a canonical-state path, either a VOLATILE 'subsystem/field' (state-volatile-v1.json, e.g. customer_service/gold) or a PERSISTENT region path (state-map-v1.json Locus.path(), e.g. bank0/gold, bank0/closeness[37], header/last_slot_used). The mutation localizes to the SAME tree the state/save pillars compare, so a mutation and a state-root divergence share one vocabulary.
event_shape.type: str — the codec type of old/new: i32 | u32 | hex | f32 (state_codec.encode_value). Bytes, not repr, are compared — a signed/unsigned skew across capture paths can't read as a divergence.
event_shape.old: number|null — the value BEFORE the write (null when unobserved, e.g. the first write of a window). Typed by `type`.
event_shape.new: number — the value AFTER the write. Typed by `type`.
event_shape.owner_va: str hex — the FUNCTION that performed the write (post-write observation at a known owner). The provenance ST-04 lacks.
event_shape.callsite_va: str hex OPTIONAL — the call site that invoked the owner, when captured.

classes.semantic: A real game-state change the port must reproduce bit-for-bit: gold, inventory quantity/slot, shop placement, day/time, a story/event flag, customer closeness, a news entry, loot, HP/status, a VM PC/stack step, a save-slot commit. ALWAYS compared. The first semantic write that diverges port↔retail is the FIRST WRONG WRITE — and, if the stream is complete for that field, it precedes-or-equals the field's state-root divergence (the ST-04/ST-05 ordering invariant).
classes.derived: A value COMPUTED from semantic state — a cached total, a checksum, a re-derived index. Compared by default (a correct port derives it identically once its semantic inputs match), but a derived-only divergence points UPSTREAM to a semantic input, not to a real logic gap at the derived field. Never the root cause on its own.
classes.noise: A capture-origin / nondeterministic write with a per-side origin — the volatile analogue of the state pillar's benign exclusions (rngcalls' hook-install origin, an uninitialized-padding write, a pointer/handle). EXCLUDED from comparison (like a benign field). An event is 'noise' ONLY with an R3-recorded reason; a mutation of unknown class is NOT noise — it is a STOP for R3 (roadmap §2), never silently dropped.

policy.comparison: first_wrong_write compares the NET per-(logical_frame, path) value (the highest-seq `new`) of the COMPARED classes {semantic, derived}, walking frames in JOIN order; the first (frame, path) whose net bytes differ — or that one side wrote and the other did not — is the first wrong write. Per-frame net (not raw seq order) matches the state pillar's per-frame root granularity, so the two localizers agree.
policy.reconstruction: A mutation stream RECONSTRUCTS a selected subtree: replay the compared classes in join order, keep the last `new` per path under the subtree prefix ⇒ the subtree's value at a frame. Verified against the captured per-frame state (state pillar) — every WRITTEN path's reconstructed value must equal the captured value (a completeness check on the stream). A field never written in-window is not reconstructable from mutations alone (correctly — no write ⇒ it holds its window-start value).
policy.idempotence: Re-observing the same (logical_frame, seq, path, new) is a no-op — a post-write hook that fires twice, or a batched + per-write observation of one store, must not double-apply. Dedup key = (logical_frame, seq, path).
policy.ordering_invariant: If the mutation stream is complete for a field, the FIRST WRONG WRITE to that field precedes-or-equals the field's FIRST STATE-ROOT divergence frame (ST-04). A first-wrong-write AFTER the state already diverged means the stream MISSED the causal write ⇒ INCONCLUSIVE (an incomplete capture), never a pass.
policy.provenance: A first wrong write whose `path` matches an ST-04 divergent leaf fills that leaf's `first_divergence.provenance` = {owner_va, callsite_va, old, new, seq} — the WRITER ST-04 leaves null.

semantic_events._note: The roadmap §7 ST-05 event list, each anchored to its canonical-state path family. `owner` is the writing function where CERTAIN (else 'attested-at-capture' — an R1 backfill as the Frida post-write hook lands; NEVER fabricate a VA). This catalog is the R3 definition of WHAT a semantic mutation is; it does not itself capture anything.

gold.note: shop gold; a sale accept adds ask, a buy subtracts price.

inventory.note: item slot quantity + the shop display grid placement.

flag.note: story/tutorial flags (f402/f404/f406 → the event_flag byte region).

loot.note: dungeon loot — not yet in the persistent map (ST-06 dungeon expansion).

hp_status.note: combat HP/status — not yet mapped (ST-06 dungeon expansion).

save_slot_commit.note: save_io_commit_slot (FUN_004905a8, parity-proof-index scenario-pillar-proven) — the whole active bank hits disk; the coarsest semantic write.
